body: The problem is by using `widgetParams` from the `renderState` you do not get the parameters used by the user but the ones passed to the connector, that can be different depending of what was done in the widget (some are not passed to the connector, others can added or transformed). So we do not really get a view of what parameters was used by the user, defeating the main purpose of the project :cry:

In the initial proposal all the widgets of the same type were merged ( https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch-rfcs/blob/master/accepted/telemetry.md#aggregate-data ) to reduce payload size and make search easier. It is not the case in this implementation anymore, any particular reason ?

IMHO it would be clearer for `extractPayload` to return the list of widget instead of updating the `payload` parameter as a side effect.

```js
payload.widgets = extractPayload(
    instantSearchInstance.mainIndex.getWidgets(),
    instantSearchInstance
);
```

I actually had a look, and while we are missing the parameters that are not sent to the connector (visual-only ones), we still retrieve all the values without their defaults, since those are only assigned on the destructuring on the connector. I think that's a fair tradeoff that doesn't require rewriting all widgets. I will however after this do a pass on all widgets, and make sure they don't set any defaults that are also set in the connectors

In the original proposal, the payload had to travel over the network, by not merging each type of widget, we have slightly more information (maybe someone uses 1, maybe someone uses 100 refinement lists, that sounds like interesting info to me)
I think in a second pass, we actually could send the visual-only parameters to the connector as well, since it's impossible for the parameters to clash significantly

I think this is a mandatory step, in the current PR we are missing a lot of information (see https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/2431b966e771d8d9386d919eb469c79b27b5b24a/src/widgets/pagination/pagination.js for example, only `totalPages` and `padding` are sent to the connector, we are missing `templates`, `showFirst`, `showLast`, etc.)

Also in most widget the parameters are send after destructuring, so with their default values.

that would require a flatMap or similar over the widgets (because of the index widget having more children), and thus seems like more code than currently. We can see payload as an opaque structure that seems logical to mutate as a whole

I see these options:

1. ignore non-connector parameters for now
2. pass the original widgetParams to makeWidget as $$widgetParams
3. pass each of the widget params to the connector (even though it does nothing)
Can we rather not attach the middleware when this condition is met?
DOM mutations should happen in `subscribe`.
